prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a parking lot collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1053; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked across the center, with the left tail lamp assembly broken and the trunk lid edge scuffed where the impact landed. Damage patterns on the quarter panel line up with the reported contact point, and the pattern is consistent with a low-speed strike from behind. Repair plan: replace the bumper cover, install a new tail lamp assembly, refinish the trunk lid edge, and blend adjacent paint. The labor hours listed are in line with the work described. The invoices submitted show each line item billed once, with no repeated charges. Nothing in our records or the owner's account points to earlier damage in this area, so the estimate is recommended as written.
